item.title: Women, girls in Gaza living 'one of the most devastating humanitarian tragedies' — UN
item.description: A senior UN Women official describes the plight of women and girls in Gaza as one of the world's worst humanitarian crises, urging the international community to act.

item.title: Two-thirds of Cuba, including Havana, hit by blackout
item.description: The electricity collapse comes as residents face daily outages of up to 20 hours amidst tightening US-imposed energy restrictions.

item.title: 'No to war': Spain's prime minister rejects 'blind servility' to US
item.description: Pedro Sanchez invokes Iraq war's lessons, vowing Spain will not be 'complicit' in actions that are 'bad for the world' simply out of 'fear of reprisals'.

item.title: 'Eager' US companies line up for Venezuelan minerals after oil grab
item.description: US officials say mining companies plan major investments in Venezuela as Washington seeks greater access to gold, coltan and other critical minerals.

item.title: Nepal votes in first election since Gen Z-led protests reshaped nation's politics
item.description: Six months after mass Gen Z protests forced Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli to resign, nearly 19 million Nepalis head to the polls to elect a new parliament.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 5 March
item.description: Iran's Health Ministry says the death toll from US-Israeli attacks rises to at least 926, and President Erdogan vows Türkiye will spare no effort to secure its borders and skies... listen for more

item.title: US identifies two more soldiers killed in drone strike in Kuwait
item.description: Six American soldiers were killed and 18 wounded when an Iranian drone struck a US logistics hub in Kuwait.

item.title: Top Indonesian diplomat discusses Middle East tensions with Saudi Arabia, UAE
item.description: Indonesia says it remains steadfast in supporting all efforts towards de-escalation.

item.title: Ecuador expels Cuban diplomats as president deepens alignment with Washington
item.description: President Daniel Noboa gives Cuban diplomats 48 hours to leave the country, marking the government's fourth major diplomatic rupture with countries in the region.

item.title: UAE, OIC denounce threat to Türkiye after interception of ballistic missile from Iran
item.description: The missile was detected after crossing Iraqi and Syrian airspace and was successfully engaged by allied defences, according to Türkiye's Ministry of National Defence.
